privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How the 0x6.ai websites, apps, and works handle your data. In short: no sign-in, no ads, no tracking analytics, location only with your permission, and we never sell any data.
privacy.s1d: You can use every work without an account or any personal details.
privacy.s2d: No ads, tracking cookies, or third-party analytics.

privacy.p1_0: This policy covers 0x6.ai and all websites, apps, and works published by 0x6.ai (including all subdomains of 0x6.ai and apps published under the 0x6.ai developer name).
privacy.p1_1: The data and third-party services each work actually uses are listed under Apps and works covered below. New works are added to that list and are covered by this policy too.
privacy.p2_0: Our websites and apps can be used anonymously. There is no registration, sign-in, comment, or form feature, so we do not collect your name, email, phone number, or other personal data. We only receive your email address and message when you choose to write to us, and we use them only to reply.
privacy.p3_0: As with any online service, your browser or device sends technical data such as your IP address, browser or device type, operating system, request time, and the URL visited. The hosting and network providers we use may log this data under their own policies for security, debugging, and keeping the service running. We do not use it to identify you or build a profile of you.
privacy.p4_0: Some works, such as map-based ones, offer a "nearby" feature that needs your location. We get your location only after you agree to the browser's or device's permission prompt; you can still use the other features if you decline.
privacy.p4_1: Location is used only to compute or show results near you. When it has to be sent to our server for that, it is used for that request only, is not stored, and is not linked to any other data. You can revoke location permission at any time in your browser or device settings. See Apps and works covered below for how each work uses location.
privacy.p5_0: We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. Some works use your browser's localStorage or the app's local storage to remember your preferences (such as the interface language). That data stays on your device, is never sent to a server, and can be cleared at any time. Our network providers may set cookies strictly needed for security.
privacy.p6_0: To provide our services, your browser or device may connect directly to these categories of third-party services, which handle data under their own privacy policies:
privacy.p6_2: When you use map features, maps are provided by Google, and Google's privacy policy and terms apply. Once you leave for a third-party site, or buy or download on a third-party platform (such as the LINE STORE or App Store), that platform handles your payment and account details, we never receive them, and its policies apply.
privacy.p7_0: These are the works this policy currently covers, with the data and third-party services each one uses:

privacy.p8_0: We use data only to provide, maintain, and improve our websites, apps, and works, or to reply to your messages. We never sell, rent, or trade data that identifies you to any person, company, or agency, unless the law requires it.
privacy.p9_0: Our websites are served over HTTPS throughout. Because we keep almost no personal data, very little could be affected; messages you send are kept in a protected mailbox and deleted once no longer needed.
privacy.p10_0: Our services are not designed for children, and we do not knowingly collect children's personal data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.p11_0: Under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act and the laws where you live, you can ask to access, review, correct, or delete personal data we hold about you, or withdraw consent you gave earlier. Email us using the contact below and we will handle it promptly.
privacy.p12_0: We may update this policy when our services or the law change. Updates are posted on this page with a new last-updated date, and significant changes will be highlighted on the site. Adding a new work only updates the list of apps and works covered, not the general terms of this policy.
